questions.q: What is the programme mainly about?
options: Garlic and its uses in cooking, medicine and religion
How to grow garlic at home
Why garlic gives you bad breath
Traditional food in the former Soviet Union
questions.why: They discuss garlic in cooking, its medicinal uses in history, and why some groups avoid it.

questions.q: Why does chef Jason Chan love garlic?
options: It is cheap and easy to find in any shop
It keeps vampires and bad luck away
It is versatile and has health benefits
It makes very spicy food less hot
questions.why: He says it's a versatile ingredient that can be used for cooking and offers various health benefits.

questions.q: What does chef Poul Erik Jensen say about cooking with garlic?
options: He only uses it in meat dishes
He can't imagine cooking without it
He uses it only on special occasions
He prefers not to use it
questions.why: He uses it in stocks, soups and many dishes: 'it's unimaginable not using garlic'.

questions.q: Who brought garlic to European countries like France?
options: The ancient Egyptians
Traders from China
The ancient Greeks
The Roman Empire
questions.why: Neil says it was the Roman Empire that brought garlic to European countries like France.

questions.q: According to Robin Cherry, what was garlic used to treat in the past?
options: Many illnesses, including the plague
Only colds and sore throats in winter
Broken bones and bad injuries
Only skin problems like spots
questions.why: She lists cancer, scurvy, the plague and respiratory ailments.

questions.q: Why do Jains avoid eating garlic, according to Neil?
options: It is too expensive to buy in India
It is bad for the stomach and digestion
It tastes too strong for most people
Pulling it up kills the plant and soil life
questions.why: He says uprooting the plant kills both it and the soil ecosystem it grows in.

questions.q: What other reason for avoiding garlic does Sonal Ved give?
options: It makes people feel tired and weak
It may increase desire and harm spiritual growth
It is only eaten at special festivals
It is used in medicine, so it isn't food
questions.why: She says it's believed to stimulate desire, passion, aggression, and affect spiritual growth.

questions.q: What has modern medicine confirmed about garlic?
options: It can cure cancer if eaten every day
It helps people sleep better at night
It can lower blood pressure and help the gut
It has no real health benefits at all
questions.why: Beth says modern medicine confirmed benefits including reduced blood pressure and better gut health.
